_comment: Tyre VFX (client only). Tune live with the panel (T). Distances in metres unless named Px. triggers.slipThreshold: a SLIDE marks past this x the tyre peak slip (03b); lockups and wheelspin mark when the longitudinal slip alone passes the peak. skid.fadeHalfLifeSec: skid marks halve every this long (rubber stays), faded in steps every fadeEverySec. spray (Wet weather card): behind each rear wheel on standing water (more than minWater), from minKph, full at fullKph and full water: ratePerSec puffs, trailing at drift x the car's velocity.
